list.name: environment
list.label: Environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment AS __text,environment AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT environment AS __text,environment AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context ORDER BY 1

list.name: deployment
list.label: Deployment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT deployment AS __text,deployment AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context WHERE environment=${environment:sqlstring} ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT deployment AS __text,deployment AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context WHERE environment=${environment:sqlstring} ORDER BY 1

list.name: chain
list.label: Source chain
list.query: SELECT role||' · '||chain_id::text AS __text,chain_instance_id::text AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} ORDER BY role
list.definition: SELECT role||' · '||chain_id::text AS __text,chain_instance_id::text AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} ORDER BY role

list.name: rollup
list.label: L2 rollup
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT rollup_id::text AS __text,rollup_id::text AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND role='l2' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT rollup_id::text AS __text,rollup_id::text AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND role='l2' ORDER BY 1

list.name: instance
list.label: Native instance
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT s.instance AS __text,s.instance AS __value FROM eez.lifecycle_coverage s WHERE s.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT s.instance AS __text,s.instance AS __value FROM eez.lifecycle_coverage s WHERE s.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Populations and assurance
panels.description: Native queue panels describe current in-memory ownership for the selected instances; chain/rollup filters apply to source/admission and canonical data. Process-wide event/candidate views use the instance filter. Canonical outcomes below require current independently checked anchors. Native counters are operational observations and can repeat after reorg. An empty queue without a recent completion is **idle / unexercised**, not verified healthy. Pending work without progress is not an idle claim. Lost events remain coverage gaps.

options.content: Native queue panels describe current in-memory ownership for the selected instances; chain/rollup filters apply to source/admission and canonical data. Process-wide event/candidate views use the instance filter. Canonical outcomes below require current independently checked anchors. Native counters are operational observations and can repeat after reorg. An empty queue without a recent completion is **idle / unexercised**, not verified healthy. Pending work without progress is not an idle claim. Lost events remain coverage gaps.

panels.title: Currently anchored outcomes · L1 watermark in selected range
panels.description: One currently verified admission per context. Missing rows mean no observed outcome; no synthetic zero. Reorgs retract these counts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT o.source->>'direction' AS direction,o.outcome,count(*) AS admissions FROM eez.lifecycle_canonical_outcomes o JOIN eez.lifecycle_coverage s USING(source_id) JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c ON c.chain_instance_id=CASE WHEN o.source->>'direction'='inbound' THEN o.context_l1 ELSE o.context_l2 END WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (${instance:sqlstring}='.*' OR s.instance=${instance:sqlstring}) AND o.evidence_class='node_reconciled' AND (to_timestamp(o.progress_timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: Admission history · retained observations
panels.description: Admission-time cohort. Local policy and unresolved_restart remain distinct; this is not current queue size.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.source->>'direction' AS direction,s.status,s.outcome,s.evidence_class,count(*) AS admissions FROM eez.lifecycle_admission_status s JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c ON c.deployment_id=s.deployment_id AND c.chain_id=(s.source->>'chain_id')::numeric AND c.genesis_hash=decode(s.source->>'genesis_hash','hex') AND c.rollup_id=(s.source->>'rollup_id')::numeric WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (${instance:sqlstring}='.*' OR s.instance=${instance:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(s.observed_at_ms/1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: Current native queue · disjoint states
panels.description: 15-second snapshots; values disappear when scrape/sample validity expires. Ready, blocked and unknown partition queued work. In-flight is separate.

panels.title: Current pending / serviceable ages
panels.description: Monotonic maximum age, not a completed latency. Serviceable ages become unavailable with stale evaluation; empty populations are unknown.

panels.title: Current age distribution · cumulative populations
panels.description: Current bucket gauges: query directly, never rate(). Compare pending/serviceable tails beside completed percentiles; +Inf is the known-age population.

panels.title: Admission → reconciliation p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Native monotonic terminal durations, currently node-reconciled; window uses checked L1 scan watermark. Outcome populations remain separate. Accepted-to-finality duration is unavailable.

targets.rawSql: SELECT o.source->>'direction' AS direction,o.outcome,count(*) AS completed_admissions,percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY o.elapsed_ns::double precision/1e9) AS p50_seconds,percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY o.elapsed_ns::double precision/1e9) AS p95_seconds,percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY o.elapsed_ns::double precision/1e9) AS p99_seconds FROM eez.lifecycle_canonical_outcomes o JOIN eez.lifecycle_coverage s USING(source_id) JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c ON c.chain_instance_id=CASE WHEN o.source->>'direction'='inbound' THEN o.context_l1 ELSE o.context_l2 END WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (${instance:sqlstring}='.*' OR s.instance=${instance:sqlstring}) AND o.evidence_class='node_reconciled' AND (to_timestamp(o.progress_timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) GROUP BY 1,2

panels.title: Lifecycle coverage · history can be incomplete
panels.description: Coverage is independent of successful receipts. No record does not establish completion.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.instance,s.last_success_at,s.collection_error,s.complete_events,s.gap_intervals,s.quarantined_records,s.lost_segments,s.unknown_trailing_epochs,s.pending_events FROM eez.lifecycle_coverage s WHERE s.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) AND (${instance:sqlstring}='.*' OR s.instance=${instance:sqlstring})

panels.title: Known readiness blockers · observations in range
panels.description: Readiness event observations, not current blocked source counts; duplicate source-state observations and gaps affect this population.

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.payload#>>'{event,member,source,direction}' AS direction,COALESCE(e.payload#>>'{event,blocked}','ready') AS reason,count(*) AS observations FROM eez.lifecycle_event_history e WHERE e.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) AND (${instance:sqlstring}='.*' OR e.instance=${instance:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp((e.payload->>'observed_at_unix_ms')::numeric/1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND e.payload#>>'{event,event}'='readiness' GROUP BY 1,2

panels.title: Request timeline · optional source hash
panels.description: At most 200 retained observations in the selected time range. A source lookup uses validated source references and process/epoch/generation or preparation identities to include related dispatches, submissions, fee variants and finishes. Source-reference projection gaps can leave an incomplete timeline; these observations are not canonical-success assurance.

targets.rawSql: WITH source_events AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT e.* FROM eez.lifecycle_source_references r JOIN eez.lifecycle_coverage s USING(source_id) JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) JOIN eez.lifecycle_event_history e ON e.deployment_id=s.deployment_id AND e.service=s.service AND e.instance=s.instance AND e.epoch=r.epoch AND e.sequence=r.sequence WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (${instance:sqlstring}='.*' OR s.instance=${instance:sqlstring}) AND r.transaction_hash=CASE WHEN lower(regexp_replace(${source_hash:sqlstring},'^0x','','i')) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN decode(lower(regexp_replace(${source_hash:sqlstring},'^0x','','i')),'hex') END), attempts AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT instance,service,epoch,COALESCE(payload#>>'{event,attempt,generation}',payload#>>'{event,replacement,generation}') AS generation FROM source_events WHERE COALESCE(payload#>>'{event,attempt,generation}',payload#>>'{event,replacement,generation}') IS NOT NULL), preparations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT instance,service,epoch,sequence FROM source_events WHERE payload#>>'{event,event}'='preparation_started' UNION SELECT instance,service,decode(payload#>>'{event,details,preparation,epoch}','hex'),(payload#>>'{event,details,preparation,sequence}')::numeric FROM source_events WHERE payload#>>'{event,details,preparation,epoch}' IS NOT NULL) SELECT to_timestamp((e.payload->>'observed_at_unix_ms')::numeric/1000.0) AS time,e.instance,encode(e.epoch,'hex') AS epoch,e.sequence::text,e.payload#>>'{event,event}' AS event,e.payload#>>'{event,outcome}' AS outcome,COALESCE(e.payload#>>'{event,attempt,generation}',e.payload#>>'{event,replacement,generation}') AS attempt_generation,COALESCE(e.payload#>>'{event,attempt,post_batch_hash}',e.payload#>>'{event,replacement,post_batch_hash}') AS posting_transaction,e.payload#>>'{trace,trace_id}' AS trace_id FROM eez.lifecycle_event_history e WHERE e.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) AND (${instance:sqlstring}='.*' OR e.instance=${instance:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp((e.payload->>'observed_at_unix_ms')::numeric/1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND (${source_hash:sqlstring}='' OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM source_events matched WHERE matched.instance=e.instance AND matched.service=e.service AND matched.epoch=e.epoch AND matched.sequence=e.sequence) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM attempts a WHERE a.instance=e.instance AND a.service=e.service AND a.epoch=e.epoch AND a.generation=COALESCE(e.payload#>>'{event,attempt,generation}',e.payload#>>'{event,replacement,generation}',e.payload#>>'{event,previous,generation}')) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM preparations p WHERE p.instance=e.instance AND p.service=e.service AND p.epoch=decode(e.payload#>>'{event,preparation,epoch}','hex') AND p.sequence=(e.payload#>>'{event,preparation,sequence}')::numeric)) ORDER BY time,e.sequence LIMIT 200

SELECT c.role,c.chain_id::text,c.rollup_id::text,v.indexed_from::text,v.indexed_through::text,v.incomplete_blocks,v.last_success_at,v.collection_error,v.frozen_reason FROM eez.index_coverage v JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) ORDER BY c.role

panels.description: Only records with a valid trace identity appear. Trace links are added when the Tempo profile is enabled; sampled-out or expired traces may be unavailable without affecting receipt history.

panels.title: Requests · distinct retained admissions
panels.description: Discover up to 200 actual admissions without knowing a hash beforehand. Readmission remains a separate row. Local-policy disposition, unresolved restart and currently anchored canonical status stay distinct. Links preserve the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(s.observed_at_ms/1000.0) AS admitted_at,s.instance,c.chain_instance_id::text,c.chain_id::text,s.source->>'direction' AS direction,'0x'||(s.source->>'transaction_hash') AS source_transaction,encode(s.admission_epoch,'hex') AS admission_epoch,s.admission_sequence::text,s.status,s.outcome,s.evidence_class,s.liveness FROM eez.lifecycle_admission_status s JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c ON c.deployment_id=s.deployment_id AND c.chain_id=(s.source->>'chain_id')::numeric AND c.genesis_hash=decode(s.source->>'genesis_hash','hex') AND c.rollup_id=(s.source->>'rollup_id')::numeric WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (${instance:sqlstring}='.*' OR s.instance=${instance:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(s.observed_at_ms/1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) ORDER BY s.observed_at_ms DESC LIMIT 200

list.name: Native restart observations
list.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(e.started_at_ms/1000.0) AS time,'Native process epoch: '||e.liveness AS text,'restart' AS tags FROM eez.lifecycle_epoch_status e WHERE e.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) AND (${instance:sqlstring}='.*' OR e.instance=${instance:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(e.started_at_ms/1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) ORDER BY time LIMIT 200

list.name: Local policy dispositions
list.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(t.observed_at_ms/1000.0) AS time,'Local disposition: '||t.claimed_outcome AS text,t.source->>'direction' AS tags FROM eez.lifecycle_local_policy_evidence t JOIN eez.lifecycle_coverage s USING(source_id) WHERE t.evidence_state='local_policy' AND s.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) AND (${instance:sqlstring}='.*' OR s.instance=${instance:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(t.observed_at_ms/1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) ORDER BY time LIMIT 200
